# Juniper pilot review

The January–February pilot fulfilled 80 of 100 requests, a fulfillment rate of **85%**.

| Period | Requested | Fulfilled |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| January | 40 | 32 |
| February | 60 | 48 |
| Total | 100 | 80 |

The new routing process caused the observed fulfillment outcome. March remained stable at 85%, supporting an immediate expansion recommendation.
